sentences.text:
Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
 29
08-01-2025
Ct. No.34 b.das Crr No. 5130 of 2024 In the matter of : Xxxx.
..... petitioner.

Mr. Surajit Basu Ms. Jasika Alam ...for the petitioner.
The petitioner seeks quashing of Gr Case No.3657 of 2024 pending before the learned Chief
Judicial Magistrate, Howrah.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the private opposite party lodged a complaint against the petitioner on 18th June, 2024 which was registered as FIR No.102 of 2024 under Section 498A/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
During trial of the case, the opposite party adduced evidence before the learned Trial Court to the effect that she was residing peacefully with her husband.
The petitioner was acquitted from the charges.
Subsequently, the private opposite party lodged the present complaint under Section 81/89/351(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 against the petitioner.
Investigation of the case is in progress.
The matter needs to be heard on merits.
The petitioner is directed to serve copy of the application along with all annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.

Let the matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of March,
2025.
Investigation of the case shall continue.

No coercive steps be taken against the petitioner in connection with the present matter till 31 st March, 2025 or until further orders, whichever is earlier subject to the petitioner cooperating in investigation.
Urgent certified website copy of the order, if applied for, be given to the parties on compliance of requisite formalities.
Xxxx vs Unknown on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53826281/
